categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes the btcsignals utility primitive in src/util/btcsignals.h
categories.rationale: Fixes an object lifecycle bug in `btcsignals::signal` where callbacks and captured state were not cleaned up upon signal destruction when connection handles outlive the signal. While this improves the correctness and memory hygiene of a shared primitive, it addresses an edge case rather than a critical node-wide failure.
